description: Land Title Settlement Department - Lunuwila, Wennappuwa D/S Division, Puttalam District - Cad. Map No. 41001 (23/0920)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, locations, and encumbrances. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it focuses on land registration, title determinations, and property ownership matters without involving government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
